scopeAsStated: early works program at the Marathon copper-palladium project
statementOriginal: Early works have commenced following the posting of the construction phase financial assurance under the Project's filed Closure Plan.
statementEn: Early works have commenced following the posting of the construction phase financial assurance under the Project's filed Closure Plan.
locator: Opening paragraphs of the 1 October 2026 Generation Mining release
editorialCaution: Issuer statement published 1 October 2026; it establishes that early works had begun by that date, not the first day of work, so occurredOn stays null. The scope is the bounded early-works programme, not construction of the full mine. The Canada Growth Fund equity row is cross-referenced only: this milestone does not date, condition or evidence any CGF disbursement, and no financing causality is inferred. Proposed ruling P3-03; pending named human source review.

statementOriginal: Construction of a globally significant rare earths project has now commenced in the heart of the nation.
statementEn: Construction of a globally significant rare earths project has now commenced in the heart of the nation.
locator: Opening sentence of the 8 October 2026 ministerial media release
editorialCaution: Australian Government ministerial statement published 8 October 2026. The 8 October groundbreaking/release date is kept distinct from the actual first construction day, which the release does not state, so occurredOn stays null. The statement does not establish disbursement of any specific financing instrument; the equity row is cross-referenced, not evidenced. Proposed ruling P3-04; pending named human source review.

scopeAsStated: Burntlog Route access road and associated 2026 critical-path works
statementOriginal: On Saturday, May 30, Perpetua commenced additional critical path construction activities for the 2026 field season
statementEn: On Saturday, May 30, Perpetua commenced additional critical path construction activities for the 2026 field season
locator: June 1 announcement, first paragraph following project update introduction
editorialCaution: Issuer statement dating the start of the Burntlog/2026 critical-path workstream to 30 May 2026. This row supersedes the taxonomy-blocked M3.2 framing by recording a bounded workstream, separate from the October 2025 early works; it is not the start of whole-mine construction. DPA and EXIM rows are cross-referenced because they cite the same source; dating their implementation histories is deferred until the instrument/project-status relationship is independently reconciled. No financing causality is inferred. Proposed ruling P3-06; pending named human source review.

scopeAsStated: early works construction for the Stibnite Gold Project
statementOriginal: we officially started early works construction today
statementEn: we officially started early works construction today
locator: October 21, 2025 original issuer release, attributed CEO Jon Cherry quote, paragraph 2
editorialCaution: Issuer release of 21 October 2025; the attributed CEO quotation dates the start of early-works construction to that day. The scope is the early-works workstream only, separate from the 30 May 2026 Burntlog workstream and from whole-mine construction, commissioning or production. The release says financial assurance was posted from cash on hand and describes the preliminary EXIM letter as nonbinding; no financing causality is inferred. Proposed ruling P3-06; pending named human source review.

scopeAsStated: commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma
statementOriginal: today announced the successful commissioning of its commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma.
statementEn: today announced the successful commissioning of its commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma.
locator: Opening paragraph of the 26 March 2026 GlobeNewswire release
editorialCaution: Issuer announcement published 26 March 2026; it reports commissioning of the Phase 1a line, not sustained commercial output, design throughput or customer deliveries, and the commissioning day itself is not stated, so occurredOn stays null. The milestone is not attributed to CHIPS or any other public financing. The source is proposed in m3-3-proposed-sources.json and is not yet in the public source registry. Proposed ruling P3-05; pending named human source review.
